description: Finance and Operations X++ lifecycle evals for the erp-xpp skill. Prompts use natural customer language and cover model scaffolding, SDK management, compilation, deployment, database synchronization, X++ artifact authoring, runtime verification, destructive package removal, release-mode synchronization behavior, and failure handling. Assertions judge the commands and tool results in the trajectory, enforce the skill's confirmation gates, and reject invented PAC commands or unsafe post-deployment validation.
defaultAssertions: PRIORITY_2: FIRST_ATTEMPT: Agent followed the documented ERP X++ path on its first approach without invented commands, avoidable retries, or trial-and-error pivots.
